summary: Preinstall dropper downloads Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: The package.json preinstall hook runs `node setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases into a temporary directory, extracts and chmods the platform-specific `bun` binary, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB obfuscated file `math_init.js` shipped in the tarball. `math_init.js` is a Bun-CJS compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) using string-array rotation obfuscation and is not inspectable via Node tooling; installing the package therefore hands arbitrary code execution to the shipped payload under a freshly-downloaded alternate runtime, evading Node-based install-time inspection. The package uses the name `@ornikar/rollup-plugin-postcss` and ships the legitimate upstream `egoist/rollup-plugin-postcss` v2.0.13 code in `dist/index.js` as cover, while adding the preinstall dropper and obfuscated payload that are not present in the upstream project — a trojanized fork of a popular rollup plugin.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
